description: This Python source file defines application settings for the backend, using Pydantic models to load configuration from environment variables. It provides a cached function to retrieve and validate these settings, specifically for Supabase credentials.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A Pydantic model representing the application configuration loaded from environment variables, including Supabase URL and anonymous key.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
